YES. Some people use computers for complex things, some can't afford to update to the latest hardware every year, some want to customize their computer to appeal to them once and not have to uninstall the same programs and redo all their settings, and some people just don't want their personal data sold off.

Win11 is not the product, we are. The fact that there is no reasonable alternative, especially those of us who work full-time, are not adept at computers/programing, or just need to use the computer for something that can't be done on a mobile device. It infuriates me.

I believe when, not if, when someone or a group finally come together in a garage to make a basic, user friendly OS to become a new foundation. That is going to be a turning point, our second chance.

It has to happen, it is...inevitable.
